title: Conditions to check for What Is Selective Sync

question.author: member_194
question.body: Could support clarify what is selective sync in the current CloudBox version? I want to avoid relying on an outdated post.

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Selective Sync documentation says: Folders you exclude stay in the cloud and remain accessible through the web app and mobile clients, but they do not use disk space on that device. Selective sync settings are per device: excluding a folder on your laptop does not affect your desktop. Selective sync, introduced in CloudBox 2.0, lets each device choose which folders are stored locally. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
